items.justification: Using evaluated cryptographic implementations is unrelated to the risk of superfluous model functionality.
Examining telemetry for anomalies and documentation content requirements share no objective.
Input validation is unrelated to threat modelling triggered by configuration change.
Update verification and permission scoping between systems are unrelated controls.
Tamper resistance of a device identity and protection of training data from access concern different assets.
Having a secure update mechanism is unrelated to API abuse controls.
Detecting unauthorized change is unrelated to due diligence on external components.
Tamper resistance of a device identity is unrelated to matching system usage to data sensitivity.
Both tell users where the product's limits lie; A the absence of updates and replacement terms, B the model's limitations and failure modes.
Limiting exposed physical interfaces is unrelated to transparency about data handling.
Debug interface protection and audit logging of prompt changes pursue different objectives.
Both use cryptography to establish that a distributed component is authentic; A within the device's update mechanism, B by publishing hashes for stakeholders to check.
Publishing a disclosure policy and recording training data provenance pursue different objectives.
Notifying a user of a pending update differs from publishing a policy for receiving vulnerability reports.
Changing an authentication value is unrelated to advance notice of model updates.
Making components updateable and securing the supply chain that produces them are distinct parts of one software integrity control.
Publishing a support period is unrelated to internal audit trails of models and datasets.
Authenticating users and authenticating distributed artefacts are different objectives despite both using cryptography.
Both govern what must happen when a requirement cannot be met; A requires the justification be recorded, B requires mitigating mechanisms and contingency plans.
Protecting data as it crosses a boundary in transit and disposing of it when ownership crosses a boundary are distinct halves of controlling data leaving a party's control.
